directUpload.body: Upload your IOF XML 3.0 start lists and results straight from this page, without the desktop client. Use the upload button <uploadIcon/> of each stage in the table above.
directUpload.title: New: upload XML files directly

officialResults.body: Once a stage is over, open its settings menu <settingsIcon/> and choose <officialIcon/> Make official. Runners see an Official badge on the results, and uploads, reset and delete are disabled to prevent accidental editing.
officialResults.title: New: make results official
